The Global Distressed Credit Weekly Wrap
provides a comprehensive summary of the
latest news on leveraged loans and high-yield
bonds, and a rundown of courtroom bankruptcy
activity. The report features stories from the US
and Europe, charts and tables detailing defaults
and default rates, covenant amendments,
returns data, upcoming loan maturities and
more.
